pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

findings.what: Extra COUNT(*) query runs on every no-match search, and the fallback to 'No items yet.' for a search on an empty table is a small design choice beyond the stated fix (though the PR describes it).
findings.fix: Optional: acceptable as is; could skip the count if the message should always say 'No items match'.

lenses.note: Bug fix with one obvious design; the new tests are the spec, and the diff does what the PR words say.
No spec file in the change.

Three new tests in test/search.test.js cover no-match, escaping, and empty table. They would fail against the old code. The empty-table test deletes rows but is last in the file. I could not run them here (CI runs them).
The only 'No items' mentions are in src and tests; no docs reference the message.
The message is escaped, the count query is parameter-free, and the empty-table path is unchanged.
The search term is HTML-escaped in the new message and the escaping is tested; the SQL is bound.
The diff touches only a worker's server-rendered text, no UI/style files.
No UI flow or browser available; the diff changes only message text.
